in_sanskrit.name: Genita
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Fertility
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Genita एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Genita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ganeshika', meaning 'Goddess of Ganesha'. In Hindu mythology, Ganesha is the god of wisdom, fortune, and the remover of obstacles. Genita is believed to bring fertility, prosperity, and good luck.
